title: DetailViewStyle absent scalar-field insertion fast slice
scope: Serialize changed DetailViewStyle identifier placement (group 280, style group 1) and model-edge mode (group 280, style group 4) when absent from the captured source.
Preserve ordered groups and aligned ASCII raw lexemes/Binary placeholders.
Verify typed same-version ASCII and Binary readback without adding repository fixtures or a CTest registration.

implementation.behavior: The copied DetailViewStyle raw carrier inserts a group-280 scalar in style group 1 or 4 when the typed byte-sized value differs from the class default and no source group represented it. ASCII lexemes and Binary placeholders remain aligned; repeated fields and cardinality are unchanged.
implementation.generatedControl: The generated secondary DetailViewStyle omits both group-280 values. The test confirms both typed values initially default to zero, edits identifier placement to 3 and model edge to 4, verifies the complete expected ordered raw stream, and asserts typed ASCII/Binary readback.

limitations: Only same-version generated DXF insertion of these single-occurrence scalar fields is covered.
Other absent fields and changed repeated-field cardinality remain fail-closed.
No DWG-origin typed output, cross-version translation, native style rendering, or consumer support qualification follows.
